scope: Basic 85-point task; optional advanced challenge not attempted
query_policy: Original question on first search; no gold or expected_answer enters agent or retrievers. No rewrite in retrieval comparison.

configs.name: dense
configs.hypothesis: Baseline: reuse Day 6 dense C and explicit chapter filters.

configs.name: bm25
configs.hypothesis: Improvement 1: lexical matching recovers rare names and exact phrases missed by dense.

configs.name: hybrid
configs.hypothesis: Improvement 2: RRF of dense and BM25 combines semantic and lexical evidence.

configs.name: hybrid_context
configs.hypothesis: Improvement 3: a larger deduplicated context may retain evidence below rank 3, with increased model cost.

configs.name: hybrid_plain
configs.hypothesis: Dev JSON refusals and copied placeholders suggest format burden on a 0.5B model. Test natural-language generation, then BM25 attribution from question + generated draft over actual context. Citation semantic support still reviewed manually; no gold used.

bm25.tokenization: Unicode alphanumeric lower-case; no stemming; English corpus

selection: On dev only: maximize AI-reviewed grounded answer mean, then Context Evidence Rate, then Evidence Hit@3, then lower total measured agent seconds, then config name. Human review pending is disclosed.
test_policy: Run baseline and frozen selected config only. No test tuning. New Day 7 questions, same public-domain corpus; not an external independent benchmark.
hit_definition: A single chunk at correct source_id/page contains a full gold evidence quote. Alternative gold entries are OR; no multi-hop cases here.
context_definition: At least one valid gold evidence is wholly present in the final source-labelled context; denominator answerable cases only.
model_cost: Local API USD 0 excludes hardware/electricity/downloads; remote cost unknown unless provider prices are supplied, never assumed zero.
query_embedding_policy: Real original-query embeddings precomputed per split in a separate process to avoid ONNX/LLM RAM overlap; test query preprocessing only after selection.
